description: Configuration for the Snowflake Task -> dbt Cloud Blueprint.

snowflake_conn_id.description: Airflow connection id used to reach Snowflake.
snowflake_conn_id.title: Snowflake Conn Id

snowflake_tasks.description: Fully qualified Snowflake task names to execute in parallel, e.g. ['POC_DB.PUBLIC.TASK_LOAD_CUSTOMERS', 'POC_DB.PUBLIC.TASK_LOAD_ORDERS']. Each entry must be DATABASE.SCHEMA.TASK; identifiers are validated to prevent SQL injection via YAML.
snowflake_tasks.title: Snowflake Tasks

dbt_cloud_conn_id.description: Airflow connection id for dbt Cloud.
dbt_cloud_conn_id.title: dbt Cloud Conn Id

dbt_account_id.description: dbt Cloud account id that owns the target job.
dbt_account_id.title: dbt Account Id

dbt_job_id.description: dbt Cloud job id to trigger after all Snowflake tasks succeed.
dbt_job_id.title: dbt Job Id

dbt_models.description: dbt model names or selectors passed to the dbt Cloud run via steps_override, e.g. ['stg_customers', 'stg_orders']. Rendered as `dbt build --select <models>`.
dbt_models.title: dbt Models

poll_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between Snowflake TASK_HISTORY status polls.
poll_interval_seconds.title: Poll Interval Seconds

task_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for any single Snowflake task to reach a terminal state before failing the workflow.
task_timeout_seconds.title: Task Timeout Seconds

dbt_check_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between dbt Cloud run status checks.
dbt_check_interval_seconds.title: dbt Check Interval Seconds

dbt_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the dbt Cloud run to finish.
dbt_timeout_seconds.title: dbt Timeout Seconds

title: Snowflake Task -> dbt Cloud
